title: Bolt
lede: A semester-long, batch-based startup accelerator for ventures that already have traction or funding.

mission.heading: Not lecture-based
mission.body:
Bolt is about helping you as a founder set and achieve goals for your venture, not sitting through lectures. You meet biweekly with your cohort and have office hours with the directors.

Founders apply and interview for a spot, and only a small cohort is admitted each cycle. This allows us to leverage our resources and attention to the fullest extent as you work to scale your company.

items.label: Outside funding — pre-seed, seed or grants
Strong traction in a pilot, partnership, or beta
Biweekly Cohort Meetings
items.text: Work through goals alongside the other ventures in your batch.

items.label: Office Hours with Directors
items.text: Direct time with the program directors.

items.label: Speaker Series
items.text: Sessions with founders and investors relevant to what you are building.

items.label: Cash Grants
items.text: Funding to put toward your venture.

items.label: Mentor Network
items.text: Directors include exited founders, former VC co-ops, and a Z Fellow.

items.label: A Separate Demo Day
items.text: Reserved seats for industry professionals, VCs, and founders relevant to your venture — with interest already from firms like Glasswing, Underscore, and Offscript.
